note: Seeded faults (sprue faults macropad): each breaks a copy of the keypad in one way, and every gate runs on the copy. A fault counts as caught only by a problem the clean copy does not have (numbers aside) that names one of its expect words; a crash or the score's volume note never counts. known: the problems the clean keypad really has, so not false alarms.
